newsitem.title: CANADA: Tanqueray finds kimberlite pipe at Yamba.
newsitem.headline: Tanqueray finds kimberlite pipe at Yamba.

text.p: Tanqueray Resources Ltd and its joint venture partners Mill City Gold Mining Corp and Cypango Ventures Ltd said on Monday it intersected a kimberlite pipe during drilling on the Yamba Lake Property in the Lac de Gras area of the Northwest Territories.

Tanqueray said drilling is continuing to delineate the parameters of the T-10 pipe, one of nine well-defined targets in the area directly east of the Torrie, Sputnik and Sue diamondiferous kimberlite pipes previously discovered on the property in 1993.
The Yamba property is located about 45 km northwaest of the Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd /Dia Met Minerals Ltd diamond discovery which is scheduled for production next year.
Tanqueray said the drill program on the remaining eight targets is ongoing.

Cypango, through a joint venture agreement, has the right to acquire a 51-percent interest on the Yamba Lake Property from Mill City and Tanqueray by incurring C$5 million in exploration expenditures on the property and the issuance of up to 300,000 shares by October 31, 1999. The interest may be increased to 70 percent by completing a feasability study on the property by December 31, 2001.
